title: Before filling in a form
topic: A staff member and a visitor are about to deal with a blank application form.
levelRationale: Use the picture to identify the speaking side of the counter and the heard situation to establish that writing has not happened yet. Contrast a conditional offer of explanation, an embedded-question request for help, and thanks for completed assistance. Neither role nor the correct response should be recoverable from narration alone.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 絵と音声で、話す人を確かめてください。答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Use the picture and audio to identify the speaker. Choose one answer.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 窓口で、二人が申込書を見ています。紙には、まだ何も書いてありません。矢印の人は、何と言いますか。
turns.translation: Two people are looking at an application form at a service counter. Nothing has been written on the paper yet. What does the person indicated by the arrow say?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 1。どこに名前を書けばいいか、教えてもらえませんか。
turns.translation: One. Could you tell me where I should write my name?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 2。全部書いてもらって、本当に助かりました。
turns.translation: Two. Having you fill it all in for me was a real help.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 3。分からないところがあったら、説明しますから、聞いてください。
turns.translation: Three. If there is anything you do not understand, please ask and I will explain.

options.label: どこに名前を書けばいいか、教えてもらえませんか。
options.translation: Could you tell me where I should write my name?
options.rationale: This is a fitting request from the visitor filling in the form, not the indicated staff member offering assistance.

options.label: 全部書いてもらって、本当に助かりました。
options.translation: Having you fill it all in for me was a real help.
options.rationale: This thanks someone for already completing the writing, but the heard situation says the form is still blank.

options.label: 分からないところがあったら、説明しますから、聞いてください。
options.translation: If there is anything you do not understand, please ask and I will explain.
options.rationale: The indicated staff member offers to explain any unclear part before the visitor fills in the form.

explanation: The arrow identifies the staff member behind the counter, not the visitor with the form. The situation says the form is still blank. A conditional offer of explanation fits that role and stage. The request about where to write a name belongs to the other participant; thanks for having the entire form filled in assumes help that has not yet occurred. あったら here introduces a possible unclear part, not a past event.

vocabulary.gloss: has not been written; nothing is entered here

visual.description: Exactly two adults at a service counter. A male staff member is on the left, behind the counter, with a simple work area behind him. A female visitor is on the right, in front of the counter, holding a blank form and a pen. The form has only empty boxes/lines, no writing. A locally added arrow identifies the left staff member. No one is currently writing, and no completed form, speech bubble or response text is visible.
